# Speedy Dialer

> Odin Digital's power dialer and CRM for outbound sales teams: fast calling, live pipelines, GoHighLevel sync and rep coaching.

Speedy Dialer is a private, login-only application used by Odin Digital's sales team. Only the pages below are publicly reachable.
